title: A structure inside the nucleus
hook: Inspect the cell and find the structure behind its function.

knows: Atoms or cells can be represented with simplified models.
doesNotKnow: The nucleolus is a region inside the nucleus where ribosomal RNA and proteins assemble into ribosomal subunits. The subunits can then leave through nuclear pores.

misconception: A familiar diagram automatically reveals the structure or function.
objective: The nucleolus is a region inside the nucleus where ribosomal RNA and proteins assemble into ribosomal subunits. The subunits can then leave through nuclear pores.
